findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Senate Second Reading, Roll Call #693 (passed 28-13)
findings.note: Senator Galey is listed among the ayes on Senate second reading of HB 958, Election Law Changes. The bill's digest (https://webservices.ncleg.gov/BillDigests/2025/H958, fetched) describes changes touching the subject: military-overseas ballots must come with photo ID or an affidavit, the deadline to provide ID after a provisional ballot rises from the third to the fifth business day, a voter registration is processed only if the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship, and a full social security number is required to register. The digest covers several bill editions, so not every item is necessarily in the version voted on.
